publications.title: UN Plan of Action on Disaster Risk Reduction for Resilience 2025 Progress Report
publications.description: This report reviews 2025 progress under the United Nations Plan of Action on Disaster Risk Reduction for Resilience, highlighting that 9 of 11 targets were met or exceeded and that pooled planning, funding and expertise help sustain and scale prevention

publications.title: Finance and capacity-building pathways for addressing non-economic losses (NELs)
publications.description: This issue brief examines finance and capacity-building for responses to non-economic losses, emphasizing practical access support, predictable multi-year grants, community participation, and stronger monitoring.

publications.title: Policy and governance pathways for addressing non-economic losses (NELs)
publications.description: This issue brief outlines governance pathways for addressing non-economic losses, drawing on 2026 symposium discussions. It calls for plan integration, clear responsibilities, stronger coordination, inclusive participation and monitoring.

publications.title: Evidence base on non-economic losses (NELs)
publications.description: This issue brief examines evidence on climate-related non-economic losses and recommends diverse, locally grounded assessment and monitoring to inform responses, focusing on health, culture, ecosystems, identity and mobility.

publications.title: Evaluation of the Making Cities Resilient 2030 initiative
publications.description: The evaluation focuses on the implementation of the initiative at global, regional and local levels, with particular attention to the role played by UNDRR as custodian and convenor.

publications.title: Global Status of Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems 2026
publications.description: This edition of the multi-hazard early warning systems (MHEWS) report provides a snapshot of the progress made in the global roll-out of MHEWS and the gaps that remain.

publications.title: Concept note: World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026
publications.description: The theme of World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026, on 5 November, is “Be Tsunami Ready: Resilience Starts With You”. It builds on WTAD 2025’s emphasis on investment in preparedness by focusing on individual and community action.

publications.title: Statement of the Second Arab Regional Forum for early warning systems and disaster preparedness: Arab call to action to strengthen early warning systems
publications.description: The Arab Call to Action outlines regional priorities to strengthen inclusive early warning systems, disaster preparedness, anticipatory action and cooperation across the Arab region.

publications.title: Implementation of the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030: Report of the Secretary-General (2026)
Cities at the frontline: Highlights from the Resilience Initiative Africa Project
publications.description: This publication details notable highlights from the Resilience Initiative Africa Project, which was implemented by UNDRR's Regional Office for Africa between August 2023–March 2026.
